companyFieldUpdates.description: CyrusOne is a global data-center platform serving hyperscale cloud, artificial-intelligence, enterprise and network customers through colocation, build-to-suit and related infrastructure services. The Dallas-headquartered company reports more than 60 operating facilities, more than 50 facilities in development, approximately 16.2 million square feet and more than 1 GW of capacity across nine countries. KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners completed the approximately US$15 billion take-private on March 25, 2022 through Cavalry Parent L.P.; their exact ownership split is not publicly disclosed. The KKR side includes Global Infrastructure Investors IV, Real Estate Partners Americas III and KKR Core vehicles, while GIP participates through GIP IV vehicles. BlackRock's 2024 acquisition of GIP's manager did not create a separate CyrusOne owner. A possible 2027 IPO was exploratory as of the cutoff, and no signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
